data.gender_notes: Aqtarun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aqtarun is a beautiful Islamic name that combines the meanings of 'moon' and 'stars'. It is derived from the Arabic language and is rooted in the Islamic religion. This name is perfect for a child who is born under the night sky, filled with wonder and awe at the beauty of the universe. The name Aqtarun carries the meaning “Moon and stars” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aqtarun usually hope their child will grow to embody moon and stars and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The stars too are believed to be the abodes of Angels and are a source of inspiration and wonder.
